messages:
camille: Quick sync  prepping the benchmark launch post + webinar. Draft idea: lead with a crisp narrative: '3x lower serving cost, without trading latency or quality' and follow with two visual hooks (latency distribution + unit-econ waterfall). Need: headline variants, 3-slide storyboard, chart specs, and inbound routing rules for demo requests. Thoughts?
ray: like the headline. suggest softening claims: "3x lower serving cost, with comparable latency and quality" for safety. keep the absolute 120ms in subhead, not headline.
camille: updated headline candidate: "3x lower serving cost, without trading latency or quality". subhead: "Measured p50/p95/p99 and token economics on production slices."
morgan: slide ideas: 1) one-liner + architecture sketch (caching, batching, routing), 2) visual: left = latency CDF (p50/p95/p99 across slices/models), right = tokens->$ waterfall showing raw vs optimized unit cost, 3) experiment summary + CTA (demo/webinar).
tara: chart specs: latency CDF uses 100k sample requests over a 7-day window; 5ms bins; annotate p50/p95/p99 and a callout for p99 tail. tokens->$ waterfall shows: base model cost, batching savings, KV cache savings, quantization delta, net cost per 1k tokens. include example rows for 1k/10k/100k users.
ray: copy variants: Variant A (data-first): "Measured on production workloads  here's the economic case." Variant B (product-first): "Ship faster: lower unit economics for your LLM features." Run headline A/B on launch.
camille: inbound routing rules: if demo_form.tag contains 'benchmark' -> add lead_score +1; if ARR_estimate > 250000 OR company_size > 500 -> route to AE queue; else -> SDR nurture + webinar invite. urgent demos -> on-call AE channel. Also flag enterprise security questions -> Solutions Eng.
morgan: webinar plan: 30-min technical deep-dive (eng audience) + 20-min customer panel (PM/ops). Registration collects workload type (chat/generation/embeddings) to auto-attach tags to leads.
tara: visual assets ask for design: exportable CSV for charts. sample CSV: 
metric,model,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1k
chat-xl,redwood-v1,38,82,210,2.40
embed-large,open-embed,12,30,65,0.90
Please add axis labels: "Latency (ms)" and "Cumulative %" for CDF; waterfall x-axis: "Cost components" y-axis: "$/1k tokens". Callout text: "p99 tail drives worst-case SLA costs."
ops-bot: draft benchmark page deployed at https://redwood.internal/bench-draft and branch 1723459999-bench. Permissions: marketing, design.
camille: next steps: morgan -> draft 3-slide storyboard by EOD Wed; tara -> provide PNGs + CSVs; ray -> set up headline A/B; i'll map inbound routing with sales. tagging folks: @morgan @tara @ray  please confirm. :thumbsup:
